"A list of dictionary entries that contain the chosen hieroglyphs. Tap on the one that most closely matches the word that you are trying to identify to get its details: Gardiner's List codes, transliteration and translation."

"Press this button to clear the 'drop' area. If you want to remove an individual hieroglyph start to drag it and a trash-can will appear in the bottom right corner of the 'drop' area. Drop it in the trash-can to remove it."
"Press this button to open a separate window, where the available hieroglyphs are organized by their Gardiner's List codes. Selecting a hieroglyph will add it to the 'drop' area."
Press this button to toggle between matching hieroglyphs in the order entered or in any order.
"Press this button to indicate that you're done selecting hieroglyphs (optional). This will reduce the list of dictionary entries to those containing that exact number of hieroglyphs."

"This tutorial will walk you through the steps of selecting hieroglyphs to find a word. If you haven't already done so, go through the 'Help' before continuing with the tutorial."
This tutorial will walk you through the steps of selecting hieroglyphs to find a word.

You can use generic hieroglyphs (see Help for details) or the actual hieroglyphs or any combination of both. The order in which hieroglyphs are added makes no difference, any dictionary entries that contain those hieroglyphs in any position will be matched.
"This tutorial will repeat with a different word. Press 'GOT IT' to exit at any time."
"As all the hieroglyphs have been added, pressing the 'lock' button will reduce the list of dictionary entries to those containing that exact number of hieroglyphs."
After each hieroglyph is added, the list of matching dictionary entries is updated. The list of available hieroglyphs is also reduced to show only those found in the matching entries.
Shows a list of dictionary entries that contain the selected hieroglyphs. Tap on the one that most closely matches the word that you are trying to identify to get the translation.

Shows a list of dictionary entries that contain the selected hieroglyphs. In this case the artist omitted one of the small hieroglyphs. Tap on the word that most closely matches the one you are trying to identify to get the translation.
"Search the dictionary's transliterations, translations or Gardiner's List codes to find matching hieroglyphic entries."
Tap here to access the transliteration keyboard.
Tap here to access the English keyboard.

"Tap here to access the Gardiner's List keyboard. Use a space to separate each code. The order of the codes is unimportant. If codes are repeated, they must appear at least that number of times for a match to be made."
"Press this button to start the search. The 'magnifying glass' key on the keyboard will do the same."
Matching dictionary entries will be displayed here. Tap on one to get its full details.
Press this button to clear the search text.
"Press this button to show all available hieroglyphs in Gardiner's list code order."
"Press this button to toggle between matching Gardiner's List codes in the order entered or in any order."

"Press this button to toggle between locked and unlocked. When locked, only whole words will be matched. When unlocked, all words containing the search text will be matched. In the case of Gardiner's List codes, when locked, only dictionary entries matching that exact number of codes will be matched."
Press this button to show / hide the translation for the matching dictionary entries.
"Shows a list of available hieroglyphs. Tapping one will add it to the 'drop' area."
"Tap a Gardiner's list category to show its hieroglyphs."
"Press this button to show all available hieroglyphs in Gardiner's list code order."
"Press this button to only show 'horizontally' shaped hieroglyphs from those available."
"Press this button to only show 'vertically' shaped hieroglyphs from those available."
"Press this button to only show 'circular' shaped hieroglyphs from those available."
Press this button to show a list of ligatures (combinations of hieroglyphs).
"Shows all the user dictionary entries. They are ordered based on their Gardiner's list codes. Tap on a user dictionary entry for more detailed information."
Press this button to add a new user dictionary entry.
Press this button to import a user dictionary.
Press this button to export the user dictionary.
"Shows the detailed information about the user dictionary entry: its Gardiner's list codes, transliteration and translation."
Press this button to delete the user dictionary entry.
Press this button to save any changes made to this user dictionary entry.
